description: This file implements a parser and related utilities for Android.bp files, including lexing, parsing, AST representation, and recursive file parsing for Android build system configuration.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Enumeration of lexer token types for parsing Android.bp files.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Lexer class for tokenizing Android.bp source code.

classes.name: Expr
classes.description: Base class for all expression AST nodes.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Parser class for converting tokens into AST for Android.bp files.

classes.name: RecursiveParser
classes.description: Class for recursively parsing Android.bp files and their subfiles.

methods.name: lex
methods.description: Tokenizes a string from the buffer starting at a given offset.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse tokens into an AST.

methods.name: parse_expression
methods.description: Parses an expression, including concatenations.

methods.name: parse_dict
methods.description: Parses a dictionary (map) structure.

methods.name: parse_list
methods.description: Parses a list structure.

methods.name: parse_operand
methods.description: Parses a single operand which can be a literal, list, dict, or nested expression.

methods.name: parse_string
methods.description: Parses a string literal.

methods.name: parse_integer
methods.description: Parses an integer literal.

methods.name: parse_ident_lvalue
methods.description: Parses an identifier as an l-value.

methods.name: parse_ident_rvalue
methods.description: Parses an identifier as an r-value, including booleans.

methods.name: create_var_ref
methods.description: Creates a variable reference node.

methods.name: define_var
methods.description: Defines a variable in the current environment.

methods.name: _read_file
methods.description: Reads a blueprint file and returns modules and environment.

methods.name: _parse_file
methods.description: Parses a blueprint file and updates modules list.

methods.name: _parse_file_recursive
methods.description: Recursively parses blueprint files and subfiles.

methods.name: find_sub_files_from_env
methods.description: Finds sub files based on environment variables and patterns.

methods.name: glob_sub_files
methods.description: Lists sub file paths matching a pattern.

methods.name: evaluate_default
methods.description: Adds default attributes to a module if missing.

methods.name: evaluate_defaults
methods.description: Applies default attributes to all modules.

methods.name: fill_module_namespaces
methods.description: Assigns namespace info to modules based on their paths.
